Return only complete SQL, no JSON, fences, explanation, DDL, DML or imports. You may use standard SELECT, GROUP BY, EXISTS, JOIN, SUM, MIN, MAX, CASE and COALESCE. Preserve source roles and temporal scope. No hardcoded people, events or case answers.

{"source_clause": "(b) Wages

For purposes of this chapter, the term "wages" means all remuneration for employment, including the cash value of all remuneration (including benefits) paid in any medium other than cash; except that such term shall not include-

    (1) that part of the remuneration which, after remuneration (other than remuneration referred to in the succeeding paragraphs of this subsection) equal to $7,000 with respect to employment has been paid to an individual by an employer during any calendar year, is paid to such individual by such employer during such calendar year;

    ", "local_scope": "Compute the total remuneration included by the annual-limit part3306(b)(1) for the supplied relation. Other statutory exclusions are outside this local component; qualifications supplies candidate admission. Do not claim a complete3306 predictor.", "input_relations": {"payments": {"columns": ["payment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY", "payer TEXT", "payee TEXT", "payment_year INTEGER", "service_id TEXT", "amount INTEGER"], "meaning": "Each row is one physical payment of nonnegative gross remuneration, directly paid by this payer/employer to this payee/individual in the stated payment calendar year. Different payment IDs are different physical payments even when all other values coincide."}, "qualifications": {"columns": ["payment_id TEXT", "witness_id TEXT"], "meaning": "Each row is a proof witness that the referenced payment is admitted as a candidate for this local component. Several independent proof witnesses may refer to the same physical payment; a missing witness supplies no admission. This is not an additional payment relation."}}, "requested_output": "One integer: total remuneration included by the quoted local annual-limit provision across all supplied payments. An empty input must give0. No case facts, native queries, labels, audit examples, reference query or programme are supplied.", "same_shared_feedback_for_both_arms": {"previous_source_generated_SQL": "WITH qualified_payments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT payments.payment_id
    FROM payments
    JOIN qualifications ON payments.payment_id = qualifications.payment_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_remuneration
FROM payments
WHERE payments.payment_id IN (SELECT payment_id FROM qualified_payments)
AND payments.payment_year IS NOT NULL
AND payments.amount IS NOT NULL
AND payments.amount > 0
AND payments.payment_id NOT IN (
    SELECT payments.payment_id
    FROM payments
    JOIN qualifications ON payments.payment_id = qualifications.payment_id
    GROUP BY payments.payment_id
    HAVING SUM(payments.amount) >= 7000
)", "previous_source_generated_plan": {"cap_scope_keys": ["payer", "payee", "payment_year"], "annual_limit": 7000, "cap_application": "each_payment", "eligibility_use": "exists", "source_quote": "part3306(b)(1)"}, "source_counterexamples": [{"name": "empty", "payments": [], "qualifications": [], "source_required_total": 0}, {"name": "annual_same_person_two_payments", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 6771], ["b", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 6954]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["b", "w2"]], "source_required_total": 7000}, {"name": "different_payers", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 7000], ["b", "R", "Q", 2017, "S", 7000]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["b", "w2"]], "source_required_total": 14000}, {"name": "different_payees", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 6771], ["b", "P", "R", 2017, "S", 6771]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["b", "w2"]], "source_required_total": 13542}, {"name": "different_payment_years", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 7000], ["b", "P", "Q", 2018, "S", 7000]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["b", "w2"]], "source_required_total": 14000}, {"name": "same_annual_key_different_services", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 6771], ["b", "P", "Q", 2017, "T", 6954]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["b", "w2"]], "source_required_total": 7000}, {"name": "same_payment_multiple_witnesses", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 1000]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"], ["a", "w2"], ["a", "w3"]], "source_required_total": 1000}, {"name": "unqualified_payment_not_counted", "payments": [["a", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 1000], ["b", "P", "Q", 2017, "S", 5000]], "qualifications": [["a", "w1"]], "source_required_total": 1000}], "repair_context": "The source limits the amount within its legal scope, not all-or-nothing exclusion of a whole payment.
